title: Spatial study — DEMO
description: A spatial sketch built from repeated lines, projection planes, and the feeling of a room becoming an image. This is sample content, not a real commissioned work.

process.text: 01 / Starting point — define one visual rule and keep the system deliberately constrained.
02 / Development — vary scale, repetition, and contrast to test how the rule behaves.
03 / Output — a placeholder example showing how process notes can sit beside the final work.
